# Luna Café

**Framework:** Astro static site

This is an Astro static website for Luna Café. General business metadata and contact details are stored in JSON format while content sections and pages are structured using Astro components.

## Pages

### Luna Café — `/`
File: `src/pages/index.astro`

- **Hero** (`src/components/Hero.astro`): Displays the café tagline, introductory description, and a link to the menu.
- **Specials** (`src/components/Specials.astro`): Shows featured weekly menu items with descriptions and prices.
- **Reviews** (`src/components/Reviews.astro`): Displays customer testimonials and guest quotes.
- **Hours and Location** (`src/components/Hours.astro`): Displays the street address and daily operating hours.

### Menu | Luna Café — `/menu/`
File: `src/pages/menu.astro`

- **Menu** (inline in the page): Displays categorised coffee, bakery, and breakfast menu items along with prices.

## Shared components

- `src/components/Header.astro`: Renders the site header with logo branding and page navigation links. Used on: all pages.
- `src/components/Footer.astro`: Renders the site footer displaying contact details, social links, and copyright text. Used on: all pages.

## Where the content lives

- **Business information (name, tagline, phone, email, address, operating hours, social media link)**: `src/data/business.json`. Update the corresponding values in the JSON object.
- **Menu items and categories**: `src/pages/menu.astro`. Modify the items inside the menu array constant in the component frontmatter.
- **Featured weekly specials**: `src/components/Specials.astro`. Modify the items inside the specials array constant in the component frontmatter.
- **Customer reviews**: `src/components/Reviews.astro`. Modify the items inside the reviews array constant in the component frontmatter.
- **Hero introduction text**: `src/components/Hero.astro`. Edit the text inside the HTML paragraph element.

## Styling

Global CSS custom properties defined in a global stylesheet combined with scoped <style> blocks inside individual components.
Global stylesheet: `src/styles/global.css`
- Color: --color-primary: #6b3e26
- Color: --color-accent: #e9a03b
- Color: --color-bg: #fbf7f2
- Color: --color-text: #2b211b
- Color: --color-muted: #7a6a5e
- Font: --font-heading: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
- Font: --font-body: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

## Notes

- Base URLs for internal links are managed by the helper function in src/lib/url.ts to accommodate custom deployment base paths.
